newsitem.title: RUSSIA: RUSSIAN AEROFLOT, TRANSAERO GET FLIGHT LICENCES.
newsitem.headline: RUSSIAN AEROFLOT, TRANSAERO GET FLIGHT LICENCES.

text.p: Russia's Federal Aviation Service (FAS) has approved licences for Aeroflot and Tranaero airlines to operate internationally scheduled flights, an FAS report said on Tuesday.
Aeroflot-Russian International Airlines received a passenger licence for twice weekly flights on the route Moscow-Tivat-Belgrad operating Yakovlev Yak-40 planes, the report said.
Aeroflot also recived an FAS cargo licence for a weekly Frankfurt-Moscow-Tokyo route operating a DC-10 freighter.
Private Transaero airline received extensions of its passenger lincences to make flights from Moscow to Berlin and Frankfurt, Ukraine's Odessa and Lvov and Kazakhstan's Karaganda.
